title: Caterpillar has emerged as a surprising blue-collar winner of the AI trade
excerpt: Caterpillar has emerged as a dominant AI player, with its products integral to the global infrastructure buildout.
content_html:
By Joe Ciolli

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Author of the First Trade newsletter

When I think of AI investing, I primarily think of hyperscalers and chipmakers. They're the two warring factions that represent the tension at the heart of the AI trade: Is it best to reward the companies making big investments, or to favor the firms being paid that money?

But outside of that critical nexus, there's a whole other world of AI stocks that may not appear as such on the surface.

One of the best examples right now is Caterpillar. As a native Midwesterner, I associate the company with tractors and farm equipment. But in recent years — as the Nvidias and Microsofts of the world have hogged headlines — Caterpillar has emerged as a critical piece of the global AI-infrastructure buildout. Among other items, it sells bulldozers, generators, and engines necessary for the construction of AI data centers.

Caterpillar did find itself in the headlines on Tuesday after a positively Microsoft-esque earnings report that crushed analyst estimates. A primary source of strength? The company's AI-enabled power and energy unit, which makes generators, engines, and turbines. The business has overtaken more traditional segments to become Caterpillar's biggest source of revenue.

The company reported a classic beat-and-raise, and also a record equipment backlog. Shares spiked as much as 13% before finishing 6% higher. That brought Caterpillar's year-to-date stock gain to 53%.

But to truly appreciate Caterpillar's role in the AI trade is to recognize its long-running market dominance. It's the best performer in the Dow since the start of 2025, posting a 142% surge over the period. Not bad for a company not known as an AI play.

The chart above shows Caterpillar's long-term dominance. But it also shows that more recently, Caterpillar has proven its AI-trade bonafides and sold off alongside chipmakers during this summer's pullback.

It fell for the same core reason: If AI demand wanes, the ongoing wave of infrastructure spending could slow as well. Live by the AI trade, die by the AI trade.

Ironically, Caterpillar's appeal as an AI stock might be its non-AI components. Outside of the power and energy segment, the company also has multiple other earnings engines, like construction, mining, and oil and gas.

Ultimately, if enthusiasm around AI cools, Caterpillar may be knocked off its perch as a market-crushing stock. But it still has other ways to keep growing its business, even if its AI dream fizzles.

Wall Street has largely caught on. The stock currently has 16 buy ratings, 11 holds, and zero sells, while the average 12-month price target sees 14% upside from Tuesday's close, according to Bloomberg data. I guess the secret is out.

作者：Joe Ciolli 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。 第一贸易通讯作者

当我想到人工智能投资时，我首先想到的是超大规模企业和芯片制造商。 它们是代表人工智能行业核心紧张局势的两个敌对派系：是奖励那些进行大量投资的公司，还是偏向那些获得这笔钱的公司？

但除了这种关键联系之外，还有一个完全不同的人工智能股票世界，表面上可能并不如此。

目前最好的例子之一是卡特彼勒。 作为土生土长的中西部人，我将公司与拖拉机和农用设备联系在一起。 但近年来，随着英伟达和微软占据了世界各地的头条新闻，卡特彼勒已成为全球人工智能基础设施建设的重要组成部分。 除其他商品外，该公司还销售建设人工智能数据中心所需的推土机、发电机和发动机。

周二，卡特彼勒公司确实成为了头条新闻，因为其微软式的积极盈利报告超出了分析师的预期。 力量的主要来源？ 该公司的人工智能电力和能源部门生产发电机、发动机和涡轮机。 该业务已取代更传统的细分市场，成为卡特彼勒最大的收入来源。

该公司报告了经典的“击败和加注”，以及创纪录的设备积压。 股价飙升 13%，最终上涨 6%。 这使得卡特彼勒今年迄今的股价涨幅达到 53%。

但要真正理解卡特彼勒在人工智能行业中的作用，就必须认识到其长期的市场主导地位。 它是道琼斯指数自 2025 年初以来表现最好的股票，在此期间上涨了 142%。 对于一家不以人工智能闻名的公司来说，这还不错。

上图显示了卡特彼勒的长期主导地位。 但这也表明，最近，卡特彼勒已经证明了其对人工智能贸易的诚意，并在今年夏天的回调期间与芯片制造商一起被抛售。

其下跌的核心原因相同：如果人工智能需求减弱，正在进行的基础设施支出浪潮也可能放缓。 因人工智能贸易而生，因人工智能贸易而亡。

具有讽刺意味的是，卡特彼勒作为人工智能股票的吸引力可能在于其非人工智能组件。 除了电力和能源领域之外，该公司还拥有多个其他盈利引擎，例如建筑、采矿、石油和天然气。

最终，如果人们对人工智能的热情降温，卡特彼勒可能会失去压垮市场的股票的地位。 但即使它的人工智能梦想破灭，它仍然有其他方法来保持业务增长。

华尔街已经基本上流行起来。 根据彭博社的数据，该股目前有 16 个买入评级，11 个持有评级，0 个卖出评级，而 12 个月平均目标价较周二收盘价上涨 14%。 我想秘密已经泄露了。
